name: prism-logs
description: Prism Logs is a log aggregation and query engine: format auto-detection (JSON, logfmt, nginx/apache combined, syslog), level and timestamp normalisation, ingest-time redaction of emails, cards (Luhn-checked), tokens, JWTs, passwords and IPs, a label-indexed chunk store with per-chunk trigram bloom filters, retention and cardinality guards, and a LogQL-compatible query engine with line filters, json/logfmt/pattern/regexp parsers, label filters, line_format, range functions, vector aggregations, topk and binary operators.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
